data.one_liner: A signature pad widget for Flutter to draw and export smooth signatures.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable signature pad widget and control logic for drawing smooth signatures based on Cubic Bézier curves. It supports various draw styles, velocity and pressure sensitivity, and exports signatures as PNG, SVG, or raw data.
use_when: You need a user interface for drawing handwritten signatures or freehand sketches.
You require signature export capabilities to PNG, SVG, or JSON state data.
avoid_when: You need advanced image editing or vector manipulation features beyond freehand drawing.
strengths: Cross-platform support across mobile, web, and desktop.
Multiple built-in drawers and export formats including SVG and PNG.
Velocity and pressure-based stroke sizing for realistic handwriting.
weaknesses: Some drawing arc modes can have performance impacts depending on the platform.
